svg.title: How one lookup races across sites
svg.desc: Timeline: you type the captcha for mirror A. After one second with no answer the app asks you for mirror B's captcha instead. B answers quickly and the result is saved. A's late answer arrives later and is ignored, unless nothing else answered within fifteen seconds.
svg.text: one lookup, three sites, first answer wins

g.text: nobody else answered in 15 s? then A's late answer is used.
